units.rawText: Somewhere in a Null Area.
units.displayText: Somewhere in a Null Area.

spans.text: Somewhere in a Null Area.

units.rawText: A pack of purple Entropics roams the Null Area, their beady eyes seemingly searching for something.
units.displayText: A pack of purple Entropics roams the Null Area, their beady eyes seemingly searching for something.

spans.text: A pack of purple Entropics roams the Null Area, their beady eyes seemingly searching for something.

units.rawText: Four in total, huh... Should I say I'm lucky? Considering there are only so many Entropics chasing me after that ruckus just now.
units.displayText: Four in total, huh... Should I say I'm lucky? Considering there are only so many Entropics chasing me after that ruckus just now.

spans.text: Four in total, huh... Should I say I'm lucky? Considering there are only so many Entropics chasing me after that ruckus just now.

units.rawText: Earhart pokes her head out from around a corner and carefully studies the Entropics' movements through a pair of binoculars.
units.displayText: Earhart pokes her head out from around a corner and carefully studies the Entropics' movements through a pair of binoculars.

spans.text: Earhart pokes her head out from around a corner and carefully studies the Entropics' movements through a pair of binoculars.

units.rawText: ...Whew. Looks like they haven't found me yet.
units.displayText: ...Whew. Looks like they haven't found me yet.

spans.text: ...Whew. Looks like they haven't found me yet.

units.rawText: Let's use this opportunity to get some rest.
units.displayText: Let's use this opportunity to get some rest.

spans.text: Let's use this opportunity to get some rest.

units.rawText: Earhart sighs in relief and slowly slides her back down the wall until she's sitting down.
units.displayText: Earhart sighs in relief and slowly slides her back down the wall until she's sitting down.

spans.text: Earhart sighs in relief and slowly slides her back down the wall until she's sitting down.

units.rawText: This was supposed to be a simple scouting run... Who'd have thought it would become a retrieval mission instead?
units.displayText: This was supposed to be a simple scouting run... Who'd have thought it would become a retrieval mission instead?

spans.text: This was supposed to be a simple scouting run... Who'd have thought it would become a retrieval mission instead?

units.rawText: I guess I'll have to apologize to Anna when I get back for going off and doing my own thing.
units.displayText: I guess I'll have to apologize to Anna when I get back for going off and doing my own thing.

spans.text: I guess I'll have to apologize to Anna when I get back for going off and doing my own thing.

units.rawText: Earhart looks down at the box she's holding.
units.displayText: Earhart looks down at the box she's holding.

spans.text: Earhart looks down at the box she's holding.

units.rawText: Model UA-FT, designation Luna... As I thought, it's from Luna's neural cloud. (Sigh) There's some liquid Entropy on it, but at least the contents are still good.
units.displayText: Model UA-FT, designation Luna... As I thought, it's from Luna's neural cloud. (Sigh) There's some liquid Entropy on it, but at least the contents are still good.

spans.text: Model UA-FT, designation Luna... As I thought, it's from Luna's neural cloud. (Sigh) There's some liquid Entropy on it, but at least the contents are still good.

units.rawText: Besides, how could I possibly not intervene after seeing that sort of thing from the air?
units.displayText: Besides, how could I possibly not intervene after seeing that sort of thing from the air?

spans.text: Besides, how could I possibly not intervene after seeing that sort of thing from the air?

units.rawText: 20 minutes ago, up in the skies.
units.displayText: 20 minutes ago, up in the skies.

spans.text: 20 minutes ago, up in the skies.

units.rawText: Earhart is flying her plane in a wide orbit over the Null Area.
units.displayText: Earhart is flying her plane in a wide orbit over the Null Area.

spans.text: Earhart is flying her plane in a wide orbit over the Null Area.

units.rawText: Entropics sighted... There's 12 of them...
units.displayText: Entropics sighted... There's 12 of them...

spans.text: Entropics sighted... There's 12 of them...

units.rawText: And logged. This data ought to be handy when the Professor leads a team to retrieve Luna's neural fragments.
units.displayText: And logged. This data ought to be handy when the Professor leads a team to retrieve Luna's neural fragments.

spans.text: And logged. This data ought to be handy when the Professor leads a team to retrieve Luna's neural fragments.

units.rawText: Earhart notes the information on the Entropics on her terminal and then hits the send button.
units.displayText: Earhart notes the information on the Entropics on her terminal and then hits the send button.

spans.text: Earhart notes the information on the Entropics on her terminal and then hits the send button.

units.rawText: Hm... Since I'm here, I might as well verify the fragments' location.
units.displayText: Hm... Since I'm here, I might as well verify the fragments' location.

spans.text: Hm... Since I'm here, I might as well verify the fragments' location.

units.rawText: (Hm? These traces...)
units.displayText: Hm? These traces...

spans.text: Hm? These traces...

units.rawText: Earhart picks up her binoculars and studies the trails of Liquid Entropy left behind by Entropic activity.
units.displayText: Earhart picks up her binoculars and studies the trails of Liquid Entropy left behind by Entropic activity.

spans.text: Earhart picks up her binoculars and studies the trails of Liquid Entropy left behind by Entropic activity.

units.rawText: That direction... and those numbers... <size=40>Oh no!</size>
units.displayText: That direction... and those numbers... Oh no!

spans.text: That direction... and those numbers...
Oh no!

units.rawText: HQ, HQ! This is Earhart! We have a situation! The Entropics are approaching Luna's neural fragments!
units.displayText: HQ, HQ! This is Earhart! We have a situation! The Entropics are approaching Luna's neural fragments!

spans.text: HQ, HQ! This is Earhart! We have a situation! The Entropics are approaching Luna's neural fragments!

units.rawText: HQ? Is there a problem with the signal? But I was just...
units.displayText: HQ? Is there a problem with the signal? But I was just...

spans.text: HQ? Is there a problem with the signal? But I was just...

units.rawText: Earhart glances down at her terminal and notices that she's been unable to send the logs she's made up until now.
units.displayText: Earhart glances down at her terminal and notices that she's been unable to send the logs she's made up until now.

spans.text: Earhart glances down at her terminal and notices that she's been unable to send the logs she's made up until now.

units.rawText: What's going on... Is there some kind of signal disruption? Or could it be... Signals from this Null Area can't reach the Oasis?
units.displayText: What's going on... Is there some kind of signal disruption? Or could it be... Signals from this Null Area can't reach the Oasis?

spans.text: What's going on... Is there some kind of signal disruption? Or could it be... Signals from this Null Area can't reach the Oasis?

units.rawText: Tsk! This is bad. If the neural fragments get infected...
units.displayText: Tsk! This is bad. If the neural fragments get infected...

spans.text: Tsk! This is bad. If the neural fragments get infected...

units.rawText: Earhart grits her teeth, then pulls hard on her control stick and flies in the opposite direction.
units.displayText: Earhart grits her teeth, then pulls hard on her control stick and flies in the opposite direction.

spans.text: Earhart grits her teeth, then pulls hard on her control stick and flies in the opposite direction.

units.rawText: It was reckless, but there was no other choice at the time. Earhart looks at the box in her hands and sighs again.
units.displayText: It was reckless, but there was no other choice at the time. Earhart looks at the box in her hands and sighs again.

spans.text: It was reckless, but there was no other choice at the time. Earhart looks at the box in her hands and sighs again.

units.rawText: (While I managed to recover Luna's neural fragments before the Entropics could consume them...)
units.displayText: While I managed to recover Luna's neural fragments before the Entropics could consume them...

spans.text: While I managed to recover Luna's neural fragments before the Entropics could consume them...

units.rawText: (I ended up being cut off from my plane instead, since I parked it some distance away to prevent the Entropics from spotting it.)
units.displayText: I ended up being cut off from my plane instead, since I parked it some distance away to prevent the Entropics from spotting it.

spans.text: I ended up being cut off from my plane instead, since I parked it some distance away to prevent the Entropics from spotting it.

units.rawText: ...I might be able to give them the slip since they haven't noticed me yet!
units.displayText: ...I might be able to give them the slip since they haven't noticed me yet!

spans.text: ...I might be able to give them the slip since they haven't noticed me yet!

units.rawText: Earhart pokes her head out, and after quickly verifying the Entropics' positions, she makes a run for it.
units.displayText: Earhart pokes her head out, and after quickly verifying the Entropics' positions, she makes a run for it.

spans.text: Earhart pokes her head out, and after quickly verifying the Entropics' positions, she makes a run for it.

units.rawText: <size=40>Skree!</size>
units.displayText: Skree!

spans.text: Skree!

units.rawText: The escape plan does not work out because even Earhart's stealthy movements instantly draw the attention of the Entropics' keen senses.
units.displayText: The escape plan does not work out because even Earhart's stealthy movements instantly draw the attention of the Entropics' keen senses.

spans.text: The escape plan does not work out because even Earhart's stealthy movements instantly draw the attention of the Entropics' keen senses.

units.rawText: The Entropics immediately converge on Earhart. Tentacles sweep madly across the ground, and they almost manage to snare Earhart more than once.
units.displayText: The Entropics immediately converge on Earhart. Tentacles sweep madly across the ground, and they almost manage to snare Earhart more than once.

spans.text: The Entropics immediately converge on Earhart. Tentacles sweep madly across the ground, and they almost manage to snare Earhart more than once.

units.rawText: (I'm faster than them!)
units.displayText: I'm faster than them!

spans.text: I'm faster than them!

units.rawText: Just as Earhart is gloating to herself about her advantage in speed, a dark shadow suddenly looms across her field of view.
units.displayText: Just as Earhart is gloating to herself about her advantage in speed, a dark shadow suddenly looms across her field of view.

spans.text: Just as Earhart is gloating to herself about her advantage in speed, a dark shadow suddenly looms across her field of view.

units.rawText: Oh no!
units.displayText: Oh no!

spans.text: Oh no!

units.rawText: Skree!
units.displayText: Skree!

spans.text: Skree!

units.rawText: Earhart clutches the box tightly to her chest and evades the Entropic attack by darting to the side. The sharp tentacle tip slices Earhart's clothing.
units.displayText: Earhart clutches the box tightly to her chest and evades the Entropic attack by darting to the side. The sharp tentacle tip slices Earhart's clothing.

spans.text: Earhart clutches the box tightly to her chest and evades the Entropic attack by darting to the side. The sharp tentacle tip slices Earhart's clothing.

units.rawText: (Crap, why was there another one around the corner!)
units.displayText: Crap, why was there another one around the corner!

spans.text: Crap, why was there another one around the corner!

units.rawText: Skree!
units.displayText: Skree!

spans.text: Skree!

units.rawText: The shrill shrieking of the Entropics gives Earhart a headache, but she grits her teeth against the discomfort, holds on tight to the box, and keeps running.
units.displayText: The shrill shrieking of the Entropics gives Earhart a headache, but she grits her teeth against the discomfort, holds on tight to the box, and keeps running.

spans.text: The shrill shrieking of the Entropics gives Earhart a headache, but she grits her teeth against the discomfort, holds on tight to the box, and keeps running.

units.rawText: The horde of Entropics casts more tentacles at their quarry.
units.displayText: The horde of Entropics casts more tentacles at their quarry.

spans.text: The horde of Entropics casts more tentacles at their quarry.

units.rawText: Uwah!
units.displayText: Uwah!

spans.text: Uwah!

units.rawText: Earhart feels something grab her calf, and then she loses her balance, falling heavily to the ground.
units.displayText: Earhart feels something grab her calf, and then she loses her balance, falling heavily to the ground.

spans.text: Earhart feels something grab her calf, and then she loses her balance, falling heavily to the ground.

units.rawText: (Oh no... My leg's...)
units.displayText: Oh no... My leg's...

spans.text: Oh no... My leg's...

units.rawText: Before Earhart can remove the tentacle wrapped around her leg, the Entropics are already poised to strike.
units.displayText: Before Earhart can remove the tentacle wrapped around her leg, the Entropics are already poised to strike.

spans.text: Before Earhart can remove the tentacle wrapped around her leg, the Entropics are already poised to strike.

units.rawText: Urgh...
units.displayText: Urgh...

spans.text: Urgh...

units.rawText: Earhart curls up, into a ball, protecting the box in her arms.
units.displayText: Earhart curls up, into a ball, protecting the box in her arms.

spans.text: Earhart curls up, into a ball, protecting the box in her arms.

units.rawText: (I'm sorry, Professor... sorry, Anna... And sorry... Luna...)
units.displayText: I'm sorry, Professor... sorry, Anna... And sorry... Luna...

spans.text: I'm sorry, Professor... sorry, Anna... And sorry... Luna...

units.rawText: ...arha...
units.displayText: ...arha...

spans.text: ...arha...

units.rawText: The tentacle falls short, and the Entropic that was about to hit her suddenly shudders. The pain Earhart expected never comes.
units.displayText: The tentacle falls short, and the Entropic that was about to hit her suddenly shudders. The pain Earhart expected never comes.

spans.text: The tentacle falls short, and the Entropic that was about to hit her suddenly shudders. The pain Earhart expected never comes.

units.rawText: Ear...
units.displayText: Ear...

spans.text: Ear...

units.rawText: (This voice is...)
units.displayText: This voice is...

spans.text: This voice is...

units.rawText: <size=40>EARHART!!!!!</size>
units.displayText: EARHART!!!!!

spans.text: EARHART!!!!!

units.rawText: A golden silhouette suddenly leaps above Earhart from behind, her sword tracing an arc through the air like a rainbow.
units.displayText: A golden silhouette suddenly leaps above Earhart from behind, her sword tracing an arc through the air like a rainbow.

spans.text: A golden silhouette suddenly leaps above Earhart from behind, her sword tracing an arc through the air like a rainbow.

units.rawText: It pierces through the Entropic in front of Earhart.
units.displayText: It pierces through the Entropic in front of Earhart.

spans.text: It pierces through the Entropic in front of Earhart.

units.rawText: Lu... Luna...
units.displayText: Lu... Luna...

spans.text: Lu... Luna...

units.rawText: Before Earhart can react, Luna has already grabbed her hand.
units.displayText: Before Earhart can react, Luna has already grabbed her hand.

spans.text: Before Earhart can react, Luna has already grabbed her hand.

units.rawText: Let's go!
units.displayText: Let's go!

spans.text: Let's go!
